in_sanskrit.name: रुद्र
in_sanskrit.meaning: the howler, roarer, the deity of wrath
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: He is the deity of wrath, who is the howler, roarer, the destroyer of the three worlds, and the remover of sorrow. He is also known as Mahadeva or Shiva.

in_hindi.name: रुद्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: रूढ़ (Rūḑh) - रुद्र (Rudhra) के नाम से उत्पन्न हुए केवल अन्तःकरणिक रूप वाले शक्तियों का नाम है। रुद्र शिव के अलग रूपों के लिए ज्योतिष्मताओं और पुराने स्मृतियों के अनुसार विख्यात है।

in_tamil.name: ருத்ர
in_tamil.long_meaning: He is the roarer or the howler, the deity of wrath and the destroyer of the three worlds. He is also known as Mahadeva or Shiva.

in_telugu.name: రుధ్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: He is the deity of wrath, who is the howler, roarer, the destroyer of the three worlds, and the remover of sorrow. He is also known as Mahadeva or Shiva.

in_marathi.name: Rudhra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rudhra is the name of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction.
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudhra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rudhra is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'rudr', which means 'weeping'. It is the name of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction, who is often depicted as having tears running down his cheeks. Rudhra is also known as Mahadeva, the great god, and is considered the supreme being in Hinduism.
